title: Detecting and Mitigating Hateful Content in Multimodal Memes with Vision-Language Models
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the ability of Vision-Language Models to detect and mitigate hateful content. The evaluation criteria and the task itself are fundamentally based on ethical and moral judgments (defining what is 'hateful'), and the definition of hate speech used in the study explicitly includes attacks on religion and other ethical considerations like mocking hate crimes.
